Internet Speed Test

Test your download speed by fetching a 10 MB file from our server three times. Shows per-run and average Mbps with a live progress bar.

Approximate — measures download speed from our server to your device. Real-world speeds vary. The test downloads a 10 MB file three times (about 30 MB total), so avoid it on metered connections.

📖 How to use

  1. Click “Start Test” and keep the tab open while it runs.
  2. The tool downloads a 10 MB file from our server three times, with a live progress bar.
  3. Each run's speed is shown in megabits per second (Mbps).
  4. When finished, you'll see the average of the three runs as your approximate download speed.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How accurate is this speed test?

It is approximate: it measures the download speed between our server and your device. Real-world speeds vary with network congestion, Wi-Fi signal and device load.

Why three runs instead of one?

Speed fluctuates from moment to moment. Averaging three runs smooths out brief spikes and dips for a fairer number.

Does the test use much data?

Yes — about 30 MB in total. Avoid running it on a metered mobile connection unless you're comfortable with that.
